title: Sell declared electrical articles only if approved
what: Sell electrical articles covered by the Part only if approved, marked and compliant with the relevant standard.

laws.title: Electricity Industry Safety and Administration Act 1997 (Tas)

sources.title: Electricity Industry Safety and Administration Act 1997 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not in the course of a business sell an electrical article to which this Part applies unless – (a) the article is approved as required under this Part; and (b) the article is marked as required under this Part; and (c) the article complies with the relevant standard for the article
